title: Tagong time
text: **Grace’s corner** We saw some Tibetan Buddhist temples in Tagong - very beautiful and peaceful. We went in a room where 20+ monks were chanting at one (no photos allowed) and it was awesome! Sadly, I had a nasty cold which was only getting worse. As a result, we had to descend (I don’t think the cold and altitude was helping) and go back to Chengdu.
